entry.title: New: Bill 167 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 24, ARTICLE 10, DIVISION 5, SECTION 24-284, SCHEDULE 32 OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO TWO-HOUR PARKING AREAS

Restricts parking in marked stalls along Highway 240 between Kika Street and Ohelo Street in the Hāmākua District to two hours, between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m., Monday through Saturday, excluding any observed holiday.
